errors.CONTEXT_MISSING: This change was refused because no signed-in user was recorded for it.
errors.DELETE_FORBIDDEN: Records cannot be deleted. Cancel or deactivate them instead.
errors.ROW_IMMUTABLE: This record is final and can no longer be changed.
errors.AUDIT_PROTECTED: The audit log can never be changed or deleted.
errors.NUMBERING_TAMPER: Document numbers can only advance one at a time.
errors.DRAFT_REQUIRED: Lines can only be changed while the document is a draft.
errors.SERIES_NOT_FOUND: The numbering series was not found or is not active.
errors.OWNER_PROTECTED: The owner account is protected: there is only one owner, who cannot be deactivated or lose any permission.
errors.APPROVAL_INVALID: This approval is not valid. It may have expired, been used already, or been given by someone without the permission.
errors.SIGN_IN_NOT_ALLOWED: This sign-in is not allowed on this PC or for this user.
errors.DEVICE_NOT_ENROLLED: This PC is not enrolled. Ask the owner for an enrollment code.
errors.DEVICE_REVOKED: This PC was revoked and can no longer connect to the server.
errors.DEVICE_KEY_EXPIRED: This PC's key has expired. Enroll it again with a new code from the owner.
errors.CLIENT_OUTDATED: This version of the app is too old (minimum {minVersion}). Update it to continue.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.SESSION_LOCKED: The screen is locked. Enter your password or PIN to continue.
errors.SECOND_FACTOR_REQUIRED: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
errors.CREDENTIAL_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Choose your own new password or PIN to continue.
errors.TWO_STEP_SETUP_REQUIRED: Set up the 2-step code on your phone to continue.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: This request was already sent with different details. Nothing was changed.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some information is missing or not valid.
errors.DUPLICATE: A record with the same details already exists.
errors.REFERENCE_MISSING: A linked record does not exist.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.BUSY_RETRY: The system is busy with the same records. Please try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: The operation took too long and was cancelled. Nothing was saved.
errors.MONEY_FORMAT: The amount {value} is not a valid number.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Please try again or contact the administrator.
